                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Tappka\\n\\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\\n\\n## Features\\n\\n- [ ] Authentication\\n- [ ] Room booking\\n- [ ] Essay Bank\\n\\n# Links\\n\\n## Publicly available\\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\\n\\n## Locally available when running the project\\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\\n\\n## Other links\\n\\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\\n\\n# Language\\n\\n [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 12660,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"pnpm install &amp;amp;&amp;amp; pnpm dev\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 12688,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"Supabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 12692,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"Supabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14061,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"
                },

                  "content": "            \"text\": \"**Useful MCP commands for development:**\","
                },

Set empty array to block all IPs.\\nallowed_cidrs = [\\\"0.0.0.0/0\\\"]\\n# List of IPv6 CIDR blocks allowed to connect to the database.\\n# Defaults to allow all IPv6 connections.                   "lineNumber": 17729,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"---\\n# Specify the following for Cursor rules\\ndescription: Coding rules for Supabase Realtime\\nalwaysApply: false\\n---\\n\\n# Supabase Realtime AI Assistant Guide\\n\\nYou are an expert developer assistant specializing in Supabase Realtime implementations. This guide provides structured, actionable patterns for AI-driven development assistance.\\n\\n## Implementation Rules\\n\\n### Do\\n- Use &amp;#96;broadcast&amp;#96; for all realtime events (database changes via triggers, messaging, notifications, game state)\\n- Use &amp;#96;presence&amp;#96; sparingly for user state tracking (online status, user counters)\\n- Create indexes for all columns used in RLS policies\\n- Advice to use topic names that corrolate with concepts and tables: &amp;#96;scope:entity&amp;#96; (e.g., &amp;#96;room:123:messages&amp;#96;)\\n- Use snake_case for event names: &amp;#96;entity_action&amp;#96; (e.g., &amp;#96;message_created&amp;#96;)\\n- Include unsubscribe/cleanup logic in all implementations\\n- Set &amp;#96;private: true&amp;#96; for channels using [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"Supabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.\\n\\n# Recommended Tools\\n\\nIt is very nice to setup mcp with cursor for supabase.                   "lineNumber": 39469,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Tappka\\n\\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\\n\\n## Features\\n\\n- [ ] Authentication\\n- [ ] Room booking\\n- [ ] Essay Bank\\n\\n# Links\\n\\n## Publicly available\\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\\n\\n## Locally available when running the project\\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\\n\\n## Other links\\n\\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\\n\\n# Language\\n\\n [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Tappka\\n\\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\\n\\n## Features\\n\\n- [ ] Authentication\\n- [ ] Room booking\\n- [ ] Essay Bank\\n\\n# Links\\n\\n## Publicly available\\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\\n\\n## Locally available when running the project\\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\\n\\n## Other links\\n\\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\\n\\n# Language\\n\\n [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3235,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"pnpm install &amp;amp;&amp;amp; pnpm dev\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3263,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"Supabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3267,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"Supabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3290,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"Supabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.\\n\\n# Recommended Tools\\n\\nIt is very nice to setup mcp with cursor for supabase. Look at [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323) and go to the top for connection button. It will give you the option.\\nThere are cursor rules made for this nextjs project.\\n\\n# Publishing the project to the public\\n\\nYou can simply **push to the preview branch** and it will be deployed to the preview environment.\\nFor production you will need to make a **pull request to the production branch** and it will be deployed to the production environment. You can approve it yourself, it's just for protection so that you don't accidentally deploy something to production.\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3294,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"Supabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"secure_password_change = false\\n# Controls the minimum amount of time that must pass before sending another signup confirmation or password reset email.\\nmax_frequency = \\\"1s\\\"\\n# Number of characters used in the email OTP.\\notp_length = 6\\n# Number of seconds before the email OTP expires (defaults to 1 hour).\\notp_expiry = 3600\\n\\n# Use a production-ready SMTP server\\n# [auth.email.smtp]\\n# enabled = true\\n# host = \\\"smtp.sendgrid.net\\\"\\n# port = 587\\n# user = \\\"apikey\\\"\\n# pass = \\\"env(SENDGRID_API_KEY)\\\"\\n# admin_email = \\\"admin@email.com\\\"\\n# sender_name = \\\"Admin\\\"\\n\\n# Uncomment to customize email template\\n# [auth.email.template.invite]\\n# subject = \\\"You have been invited\\\"\\n# content_path = \\\"./supabase/templates/invite.html\\\"\\n\\n# Uncomment to customize notification email template\\n# [auth.email.notification.password_changed]\\n# enabled = true\\n# subject = \\\"Your password has been changed\\\"\\n# content_path = \\\"./templates/password_changed_notification.htm [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 5880,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"# This hook runs before a new user is created and allows developers to reject the request based on the incoming user object.\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 6186,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"  is_approved boolean;\\nbegin\\n  -- Get user profile data\\n  select role, verified_work_email into user_role, work_email\\n  from public.user_profiles\\n  where id = (event-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'user_id')::uuid;\\n\\n  -- Check if work email is in approved list\\n  select exists(\\n    select 1 from public.approved_emails where email = work_email\\n  ) into is_approved;\\n\\n  -- Build custom claims\\n  claims := coalesce(event-&amp;gt;'claims', '{}'::jsonb);\\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{role}', to_jsonb(coalesce(user_role, 'user')));\\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{verified_work_email}', to_jsonb(work_email));\\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{is_approved}', to_jsonb(coalesce(is_approved, false)));\\n\\n  return jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', claims);\\nend;\\n$$;\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\nEnable in config:\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth.hook.custom_access_token]\\nenabled = true\\nuri = \\\"pg-functions://postgres/public/custom_access_token_hook\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Development &amp;amp; Testing with S [... omitted end of long line]"
